annotations.title: Tender Feed: EU, UK and US Public Procurement, One Schema

description: Search public tenders across TED (EU), Find a Tender (UK) and SAM.gov (US) in one normalised schema: title, buyer organisation, country, CPV codes, deadline, estimated value, procurement method and source link. Filter by keyword, CPV prefix, country and publication date; export as OCDS JSON. Buyer organisations only, no contact persons. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

country.description: Buyer country (ISO 3166, 2 or 3 letters) for TED. Find a Tender is always GB and SAM.gov always US.

cpv.description: CPV codes or prefixes with a trailing * (for example 72* for IT services). Applies to TED and Find a Tender.

format.description: notices returns the normalised list; ocds adds an OCDS 1.1 release package.

keyword.description: Words that must appear in the title or description (letters, digits, spaces, hyphens).

publishedSince.description: Only notices published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 7 days ago. Use the date of your last run for new tenders only.

samApiKey.description: Your own free SAM.gov API key, only needed for the sam source. Never stored.

sources.description: Which sources to search: ted (EU), uk-fts (UK Find a Tender), sam (US SAM.gov, needs samApiKey). Default: ted and uk-fts.
